annotations.title: Ask humans whether a voice sounds human

description: Real people listen to an audio clip and rate how human it sounds (1–5), with comments. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio clip (MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV, max 1.8 MB).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

question.description: Optional question rated 1–5, e.g. 'How friendly does this sound?'

name: request_voice_check
